subtitle: Sydney's southernmost surf suburb, the only Sydney beach with its own heavy-rail terminus, and the site of Australia's worst outbreak of race-based mob violence in December 2005.
spike_statement: A lifeguard scuffle and 270,000 texts turned this beach into the site of Australia's worst race riot on 11 December 2005, still shaping law two decades later.

levers.photo_tone: Flat late-morning light over grey-green Tasman swell, red-and-yellow patrol flags and the lifeguard tower in the foreground, low beachfront apartments behind -- a working suburban beach, not a resort postcard
